title: Once-Daily Oral Agent Added to Metformin in Adults With Type 2 Diabetes
summary: Phase 3 study of an investigational oral glucose-lowering drug added to metformin in adults with inadequately controlled type 2 diabetes.
inclusion: Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus for at least 6 months before screening
HbA1c between 7.0% and 10.5% (inclusive) at screening
On a stable dose of metformin (at least 1000 mg/day) for at least 8 weeks
Body mass index (BMI) between 25 and 40 kg/m2
Willing and able to provide written informed consent
exclusion: Type 1 diabetes mellitus or history of diabetic ketoacidosis
Myocardial infarction or stroke within 6 months before screening
Use of insulin within 3 months before screening

title: Novel Antihypertensive in Uncontrolled Essential Hypertension
summary: Randomized trial of a new blood-pressure-lowering drug in patients whose hypertension remains uncontrolled on standard therapy.
inclusion: Diagnosis of essential (primary) hypertension
Seated office systolic blood pressure of 140 mmHg or higher at screening
Currently taking at least 2 antihypertensive medications
Willing and able to provide written informed consent
exclusion: Known secondary hypertension (e.g., renal artery stenosis, primary aldosteronism, pheochromocytoma)
Heart failure with left ventricular ejection fraction below 40%

title: Biologic Therapy for Severe Uncontrolled Asthma
summary: Study of an add-on monoclonal antibody in patients with severe asthma who continue to have exacerbations despite inhaled therapy.
inclusion: Physician-diagnosed asthma for at least 12 months
Using medium- or high-dose inhaled corticosteroids
At least 2 asthma exacerbations requiring systemic (oral) corticosteroids in the past 12 months
Pre-bronchodilator FEV1 between 40% and 80% of predicted
Willing and able to provide written informed consent
exclusion: Current smoker or smoking history of 10 pack-years or more
Diagnosis of COPD or other clinically significant lung disease
Current use of any biologic therapy for asthma (e.g., omalizumab, mepolizumab, dupilumab)

title: Targeted Antibody-Drug Conjugate in HER2-Positive Breast Cancer
summary: Open-label study of an antibody-drug conjugate in women with HER2-positive breast cancer.
inclusion: Histologically confirmed HER2-positive breast cancer
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1
Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) of 50% or higher
Willing and able to provide written informed consent

title: Kidney-Protective Therapy in Albuminuric Chronic Kidney Disease
summary: Trial evaluating whether a new drug slows kidney function decline in patients with CKD and albuminuria.
inclusion: Chronic kidney disease with eGFR between 25 and 60 mL/min/1.73m2
Urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (UACR) of 200 mg/g or higher
On a stable, maximum tolerated dose of an ACE inhibitor or ARB for at least 4 weeks
Willing and able to provide written informed consent
exclusion: Kidney transplant recipient or currently receiving dialysis
